meta.build_type: release (cargo --release: opt-level 3, lto fat, codegen-units 1, panic abort)

extension.note: no git repository; source hash = sha256 over engines/duckdb/{Cargo.toml,Cargo.lock,src/*.rs}

pinning.note: logical CPUs 0-15 = 8 P-cores x 2 SMT; 16-31 = E-cores

load_before.note: load average is recorded for information only; the gate is instantaneous CPU and GPU use

vss.name: vss
vss.index_options: defaults (metric='ip'; vss defaults ef_construction=128, ef_search=64, M=16)

setup.sql_index: SELECT facet, AVG(value), count(*) FROM (SELECT facet, value FROM adm  ORDER BY array_negative_inner_product(emb, ?::FLOAT[384]) LIMIT {k}) GROUP BY facet
setup.sql_filtered_full_table: SELECT facet, AVG(value), count(*) FROM (SELECT facet, value FROM full_t WHERE filter_num >= 2000 ORDER BY array_negative_inner_product(emb, ?::FLOAT[384]) LIMIT {k}) GROUP BY facet

load_after.note: load average is recorded for information only; the gate is instantaneous CPU and GPU use
